risks.title: CI does not run on push to main after final merge
risks.finding: Both BE/FE GitHub Actions push branch filters only phase3b/**; PR main covered. Owner requires postmerge main E2E source checks.
risks.recommended_resolution: Add main and phase3-dev to push triggers (with reviewed scope), ensure job on merged source SHA; run green in candidate and after final merge.
risks.revalidation_evidence: Both workflows now run on pull_request main and push main; phase3-dev push duplication removed. No main merge performed.

risks.title: No main branch protection
risks.finding: GitHub main branch protected=false in both source repos; direct pushes or accidental merge risk not prevented at GitHub policy layer.
risks.recommended_resolution: Owner review GitHub branch ruleset requiring PR+required CI/no force-push, handling repo account capabilities; verify effective protection.
risks.revalidation_evidence: Main protected=false for BE/FE. GitHub connected actions offer branch/ruleset READ only; changing settings requires separately authorized action/API capability.

risks.title: Trust assertion cryptography unratified
risks.finding: Internal workload algorithm, JWKS/distribution, key rotation, skew, TTL and nonce replay store are PENDING_SECURITY_ADR.
risks.recommended_resolution: Approve explicit signed versioned nonprod trust profile and meaningful positive/negative signing/rotation/replay contract vectors before private handlers.
risks.revalidation_evidence: Cryptographic EdDSA RFC8037 synthetic verifier checks actual sodium signatures and nonce/replay, but proposed key distribution, rotation, replay-store fail-closed policy not owner ratified.

risks.title: Crash/failover persistence tests are ID-to-answer assertions
risks.finding: validate-persistence maps E01–E08 fixture IDs to fixed expected output; does not implement independent replay/outbox/booking state behavior.
risks.recommended_resolution: Replace tautological cases with deterministic executable state transition/fault-injection contract model (non-production, no DB required in 3B).
risks.revalidation_evidence: Replaced E01..E08 answer lookup with input-driven failure state transitions and negative fault mutants; BE 42 persistence model assertions PASS.

risks.title: Grant and migration compatibility test gaps
risks.finding: Four owned DB grants represented as strings; no executable nonprod grant/migration compatibility fixture tests.
risks.recommended_resolution: Add parser/schema assertions for owner-grant policy and versioned migration compatibility fixtures; defer live PG grants/txns Phase4+.
risks.revalidation_evidence: Four DB owner/grant model plus three additive/breaking migration cases tested; actual PostgreSQL grants and schema apply explicitly Phase4+.

risks.title: Source rights attestation hash validation too weak
risks.finding: Knowledge compatibility test rejects forged release only when source SHA length invalid; FE attestation accepts arbitrary well-formed 40/64 char hashes; no expected-hash match.
risks.recommended_resolution: Add synthetic valid-length wrong-digest/incorrect source commit negatives against independent expected content/provenance manifest; defer real signatures/Studio rights service to Phase8.
risks.revalidation_evidence: BE/FE now deny plausible wrong commit/digest against separately pinned synthetic expected values; real Studio rights signer/Knowledge release remains Phase8.

risks.title: FE privacy scanner extension coverage incomplete
risks.finding: scanPublicOutput reads .html/.xml/.json/.js/.txt; does not scan all possible text/CSS/SVG/map/public asset references, though content allowlists and Next export are green.
risks.recommended_resolution: Expand scanner/bundle risk inventory and synthetic leak tests for other emitted public text/static output; preserve fail-closed output scan.
risks.revalidation_evidence: FE scanner now rejects draft routes across CSS/SVG/maps/filenames, unknown extensions, and only allows whitespace placeholders in known asset dirs; 9 Node tests + build PASS.

risks.title: Consumer/provider compatibility fixtures are static golden strings
risks.finding: 26/19/9 set comparisons catch route/cap/event drift, not JSON request/response backward compatibility through mock provider and consumer contracts.
risks.recommended_resolution: Introduce executable no-network contract mock provider/consumer with method, status and DTO schema cases, positive/negative compatibility fixtures.
risks.revalidation_evidence: BE source mock 136 assertions across all 26 method/path operations, client/cap/owner/ACL negative cases and request/response DTO mutation compatibility; live HTTP provider deferred.

risks.title: CI mutation proof and non-production claims incomplete
risks.finding: Some intentionally modified arrays are tested in PHP, but no systematic mutant FAIL matrix nor complete independent secrets/log/preview isolation verification.
risks.recommended_resolution: Add intentional mutants (invalid route/schema, role escalation, draft artifact, event drift), show CI fails as designed; validate redaction/no production writes.
risks.revalidation_evidence: Negative mutations for removed bearer, incorrect 401, wrong owner, breaking DTO, outbox booking flags, draft assets and valid-shape forged digest; GitGuardian green BE+FE; not exhaustive security guarantee.

risks.title: Real Keycloak issuer, PKCE and signed workload delegation untested
risks.finding: Contract says synthetic booleans; no live lms-user/lms-admin clients, real JWT cryptography, provider auth or HRM mapper isolation runtime attestation.
risks.recommended_resolution: Phase4 isolated nonprod Keycloak provision/signed token tests after approved trust ADR and separate work order; must not be promoted to 3B runtime PASS.
risks.revalidation_evidence: Real Keycloak clients and cryptographic audience/issuer runtime remain Phase4 nonproduction separate work order.

risks.title: Durable state and booking race unverified
risks.finding: No production/nonprod PG migration or concurrent booking, unique occupied slot, real outbox crash/inbox replay, Redis-loss or Audit reconciliation integration test.
risks.recommended_resolution: Phase4–7/11 controlled PostgreSQL lab with owner grants, transaction/race and recovery tests; no cross-DB writes.
risks.revalidation_evidence: PG grants, booking race, outbox durability, Audit reconciliation require authorized live DB test harness; Phase3 only synthetic.

risks.title: Studio/Knowledge and private search authoritative provenance not live
risks.finding: Published canon rights, signed source digest, Knowledge ingest release verification, ACL result filtering and rollback remain contract-only.
risks.recommended_resolution: Phase8 rights approved with Studio source attestation and Knowledge ingest gate, fail-closed ACL tests, rollback proof.
risks.revalidation_evidence: Signed Studio canon redistribution rights and Knowledge index private ACL runtime Phase8.

risks.title: Service provider endpoints not integrated or deployed
risks.finding: Contract source contains schemas and model fixture tests; six Laravel jobs green on skeleton applications, no 26 public handlers or real provider/consumer requests verified.
risks.recommended_resolution: Phase4+ provider implementation must demonstrate 401/403/object ACL, idempotency and route ownership; no Phase3 runtime certification.
risks.revalidation_evidence: Real Laravel business controller/provider and 26 method route support not implemented during Phase3 contract stage.

risks.title: 28/28 final acceptance and owner source-merge signature missing
risks.finding: 13 PASS_SCOPED, 1 PASS_TRACE_ONLY, 13 PARTIAL and 1 BLOCKED; owner approved candidate only, central PRs still draft.
risks.recommended_resolution: Resolve required 3B contract/CI deficits; refresh SHA+CI and 44 trace, obtain explicit final source merge approval; separate Phase4 work order.
risks.revalidation_evidence: 28 gate matrix is 24 scoped PASS +1 trace-only +2 partial +1 blocked; owner final merge signoff and Phase4 separate work order not received.
